name: Ljubljana
tagline: A green riverside capital near Lake Bled
summary: Ljubljana is a compact, car-free capital along the Ljubljanica river, shaped by architect Jože Plečnik. Ride the funicular to the castle, sip coffee by the Triple Bridge and day-trip to Lake Bled and the Postojna caves.
seasonNote: Spring to autumn is lovely; December has festive lights.
arrival: Ljubljana Airport is 30 minutes away; trains from Zagreb and Vienna.
gettingAround: Walk or bike; buses to Bled.
cashTip: Cards work widely; carry a little cash for mountain huts and bakeries.
foodTip: Kranjska klobasa sausage, štruklji and potica.
buyTip: Honey, salt from Piran and wine.
